items.title: Checkout → Taipei Main → THSR Boarding
items.hours: THSR Taipei Station: operation 06:00–24:00; ticketing 06:00 until last train departure
items.getThere: THSR Taipei Station is at No.3 Beiping W. Rd. (Zhongzheng). It links by B1/B3 corridors to the TRA Taipei Station gate areas; follow THSR signs down to the THSR concourse and gates.
highlights: Pick up or check the reserved ticket before 8:45; trains in this window leave at 08:31, 08:46 and 09:01 (Dec 4 timetable).
Carry-on limit per piece: ≤150 cm long and ≤220 cm length+width+height; 40 kg total per passenger.
tips: Large suitcases go in the luggage area at the car ends; small bags on the rack above window seats.
No hot/cold drinking water is provided on board — buy water before the gates.
items.watch: Reserved tickets are valid only for the date and train number printed; miss it and you lose the seat.

items.title: THSR: Taipei → Zuoying
items.cost: Standard reserved NT$1,490 · Non-reserved NT$1,445 · Business NT$2,440 (adult, one way)
items.getThere: Non-reserved cars are 10–12 on most of these trains (9–12 on 0615). Car 6 is the Business Car. 0117 (09:31) is the fastest at 1h34 and still arrives 11:05.
highlights: 0615 (08:46→10:45) or 1307 (09:01→11:00) match the plan; 0207 (08:31→10:10) buys an extra 50 min in Zuoying.
Every car has at least one large-luggage area by the doors.
Toilets in cars 1/3/5/7/9/11; cold-drink vending in cars 1, 5 and 11.
tips: Standard-car seats swivel 180° so a group can face each other.
Early-bird discount was showing on train 0813 at time of check; discounts are capped and change — check the booking system.
items.watch: Non-reserved tickets are valid for the date but do not guarantee a seat. Do not eat strong-smelling food on board.

items.title: Store Luggage at New Zuoying
items.getThere: THSR Zuoying Station, No.105 Gaotie Rd. The 2F corridor links to TRA Xinzuoying Station; Global Mall (Boulder Space, 3F) occupies 1–4F of the Xinzuoying station building at 站前北路1號.
highlights: THSR runs paid coin lockers (寄物櫃) at every station; the Zuoying floor map lists a Baggage Storage point.
Storing here keeps bags beside the climbing gym, which is in the same station complex.
tips: Use the station floor map (1F/2F) on the THSR Zuoying page to find the locker bank before you arrive.
Global Mall 2F food hall: some counters from 07:30, restaurants from 11:00 — handy for a snack while sorting bags.
items.watch: Locker prices and sizes are not published on the THSR site; large suitcases may not fit small lockers — have a fallback (hotel can't take bags until it is open to you).

items.title: Lunch at Zuoying — Fenyang Wonton (Founding Shop)
items.getThere: 高雄市左營區左營大路84號 (old Zuoying) — this is not inside the station complex (高鐵路105號 / 站前北路1號); budget a taxi each way.
highlights: This address is the founding shop of 老左營汾陽餛飩 (opened 1954), tel 07-588-7000.
Order the hand-wrapped wontons: fresh pork hind-leg filling, made by hand daily.
Add 祖傳鹹湯圓 — savoury glutinous dumplings filled with pork and shiitake.
tips: Wonton soup plus salty tangyuan is a solid pre-climb protein lunch.
Call ahead (07-588-7000) to confirm it is open Friday lunchtime — hours are not on the official site.
items.watch: Opening hours for the founding shop are not published by the operator; branch hours differ (e.g. 德賢店 11:00–23:00).

items.title: Boulder Space Zuoying — Indoor Bouldering
items.cost: Single entry adult NT$350 + shoe rental NT$80 = NT$430 (Global Mall Online voucher, pickup at the Boulder Space counter)
items.getThere: Global Mall Xinzuoying, 高雄市左營區站前北路1號 3F — same building as TRA Xinzuoying and connected to THSR Zuoying.
highlights: Bouldering-focused gym with varied wall angles and training equipment; suits beginners and experienced climbers.
Shoe rental is bundled in the NT$430 online product.
tips: Buy the NT$430 product on Global Mall Online (credit card, LINE Pay, JKOPAY, 悠遊付, iPASS MONEY) to skip pricing questions at the desk.
Mall 2F has food outlets for a post-climb protein snack.
items.watch: Gym-specific hours and walk-in rules are not on an official page; the mall's 3F hours (Fri 11:00–22:00) are the outer limit.

sources.label: Global Mall Online: Boulder Space single entry + shoes

items.title: Collect Luggage → Airline Inn Check-In
items.getThere: From Zuoying take the KMRT Red Line to Kaohsiung Main Station (R11), then walk 3–5 min to 高雄市三民區建國三路33號. TRA Kaohsiung Station is also a 3–5 min walk.
highlights: 134-room hotel in front of Kaohsiung Main Station; tel +886-7-285-3888.
Staff languages: Chinese, English, Japanese.
tips: Arriving before 3 PM: ask the front desk to hold bags, then head to Pier-2 and check in later.
Since 1 Jan 2025 no single-use toiletries are placed in rooms — ask the front desk if needed.
items.watch: Hotel is entirely non-smoking; only partner car parks (paid, first-come).

items.title: Pier-2 / Warehouse & Harbour Corridor
items.hours: Fri 10:00–20:00 (Mon–Thu 10:00–18:00). Ticketed exhibits: last ticket sale 19:00 on Fri. Pier-2 Tower Fri 10:00–19:30
items.cost: Outdoor areas free. 駁二當代館 combo (C5 + 舊事倉庫) NT$120; single exhibit NT$80. Pier-2 Tower NT$10 coin entry
items.getThere: 大勇路1號, 鹽埕. Nearest stops: KMRT Yanchengpu (O2), Light Rail 駁二大義 / 駁二蓬萊. Hamasen MRT/LRT for the west end.
highlights: Walk the Dayong (P2/P3/C-warehouses) → Dayi (C6–C11) → Penglai (B-warehouses) strip along the light-rail line.
Pier-2 Tower: NT$10 coin entry for a harbour view.
Continue west to 舊打狗驛故事館 and 哈瑪星鐵道園區 if time allows.
tips: Tickets are sold at the C5 問吧 desk (Dayong) and C7 desk (Dayi).
Exhibitions: no food/drink, no flash, no running.
items.watch: 2026駁二動漫祭 runs Sat–Sun Dec 5–6 in P2/P3/自行車倉庫 and B3/B4/B9 — expect setup or closures there on Fri Dec 4.

items.title: Yancheng Early Dinner
items.getThere: KMRT Yanchengpu (O2) is the hub; the Bib Gourmand shops are a short walk in the 鹽埕 grid.
highlights: 鴨肉珍 — Michelin Bib Gourmand; duck rice and duck meat, a lean protein pick that runs past 8 PM.
Other Bib picks in Yancheng named by Kaohsiung Tourism: 北港蔡三代筒仔米糕, 鄭家切仔麵.
tips: Go to 鴨肉珍 first — it closes 20:20.
Pair duck with a meat-heavy side to hit the protein target before E7PLAY.
items.watch: 鄭家切仔麵 closes at 15:00 daily — not a dinner option.

items.title: E7PLAY Sanduo — Bowling, Billiards, Darts, Arcade
items.cost: Fri entry after 18:00 = holiday rate (non-member): 3 h NT$350, 5 h NT$430, plus 10% cleaning fee (3 h = NT$385). Overtime NT$60 per 30 min
items.getThere: 高雄市苓雅區三多一路335號2F (above 小北百貨, opposite 三信家商), tel (07)727-0853. KMRT 五塊厝 Exit 4 is the operator's suggested approach.
highlights: One ticket covers bowling, billiards, darts, KTV booths, arcade machines and massage chairs.
Glow bowling (夜光保齡球) session at 23:00 — right at the end of a 9 PM entry.
tips: A 9 PM entry on a 3 h ticket ends at midnight — matches the plan.
First-time E7 app sign-up gives a buy-one-get-one ticket coupon; member discounts need the in-app card.
items.watch: Card payments listed are Taiwan-issued Visa/Mastercard/JCB, LINE Pay, TWQR — bring cash. Under-18s, or adults without ID, must leave by midnight.
